prerequisites: n8n installed (docker recommended: docker run -d -p 5678:5678 n8nio/n8n)
API credentials: Anthropic (Claude), Bright Data, Clearbit, Stripe, Google Workspace
Slack workspace with incoming webhooks enabled
setup_steps: 1. Import each workflow JSON into n8n
2. Configure credentials for each service (Settings > Credentials)
3. Update webhook URLs in your Postgres triggers
5. Enable all workflows and monitor execution logs
installation_instructions.postgres_webhook_setup: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION notify_n8n_lead_qualified() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $ BEGIN PERFORM pg_notify('n8n_webhook', json_build_object('event', 'lead_qualified', 'lead_id', NEW.id)::text); RETURN NEW; END; $ LANGUAGE plpgsql; CREATE TRIGGER lead_qualified_trigger AFTER UPDATE ON leads FOR EACH ROW WHEN (OLD.status != 'qualified' AND NEW.status = 'qualified') EXECUTE FUNCTION notify_n8n_lead_qualified();

key_metrics: Time to first response (target: <4 hours for score >0.8)
Invoice payment time (target: 80% paid within 30 days)
error_handling: All workflows have error notification nodes
Failed executions trigger Slack alerts to #tech-alerts channel
Webhook errors logged to activity_log table
Daily health check workflow validates all integrations
